scope: Review reasoning and evidence notes; not product verification
original_design_excerpt_N01: DB worker 异常或确认丢失时立即关闭派发入口、标记存储状态未知；不凭 Promise 超时重发外部命令。恢复需持锁重开数据库、按 operation/intent 查询事实，并执行第 9 节核对流程。
original_design_excerpt_N02: 全部文件和 manifest 成功后 fsync 文件及目录，同文件系统原子 rename 到不可变 archive generation；最后 DB 事务登记发布。恢复时识别未登记的完整 generation，校验后补登记；未完成 staging 不对下游可见。
excerpt_origin: Initial full-text read of technical-design.md, before author N01/N02 revisions; copied from actual reviewer tool output. Initial preview reports 257 lines.

references.finding: terminate is asynchronous; its Promise resolves when exit is emitted.
Child lifecycle/message/close are distinct; publishing requires explicit writer-exit ordering.
Synchronous transactions are compatible with a dedicated DB worker and should not span await.
TypeBox schema type inference is available; runtime validation still required.
